caption:
The super deduction plenty of sole traders lose on paperwork.

To claim personal super contributions as a tax deduction, you give your fund a notice of intent, and the fund must acknowledge it in writing before you claim. The deadline is the earlier of the day you lodge your return or the end of the next income year. Aged 67–74? You'll also need to meet the work test (40 hours in 30 consecutive days) or its exemption.

It counts towards your concessional cap: $32,500 in 2026–27.

Save this for June.

General info only, not personal advice.
